text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Farmcrest Drive, between Pharmacy Avenue and Meadowacres Drive. Staff's assessment indicates that the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Farmcrest Drive.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed humps on Farmcrest Drive, between Pharmacy Avenue and Meadowacres Drive. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway for the installation of five speed humps on Farmcrest Drive, between Pharmacy Avenue and Meadowacres Drive, generally as shown on Attachment 4 to the report (November 20, 2024) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services. 3. Subject to approval of Parts 1 and 2 above, Scarborough Community Council reduce the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Farmcrest Drive, between Pharmacy Avenue and Victoria Park Avenue in conjunction with the installation of speed humps.
